Name: Delumped Trash Bear
Author: IllogicalMoodSwing
Description:
About two years ago, I wanted to delump the Trash Bear at the same time I [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30776]delumped the Bear[/url]. Then I sat on it for some reason, and 1.6 came out and introduced the racoons. And then I was stuck with a mod that just kind of added a racoon.

But now, it's Modfest! And I have a working mod! So I'd like to share it anyway.

Install
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Choose which variant you'd prefer, either using the generated [font=Courier New]config.json[/font][font=Arial] [/font]or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿[font=Arial].[/font]
[/list]
